requirements.desc: `deployPresetCopies(workRoot, { presetKeys: ["base"], languages })` must not create, update, or return `.senti/templates/<lang>/docs/creating_presets.md` for any configured language.
requirements.note: R1: deployPresetCopies does not create or return project-local creating_presets.md

requirements.desc: If `.senti/templates/<lang>/docs/creating_presets.md` already exists before full `senti upgrade` or `deployPresetCopies()` runs, its file contents must remain unchanged after the operation, including when legacy rename tokens are present.
requirements.note: R2: existing project-local creating_presets.md remains unchanged through upgrade write paths

requirements.desc: `deployPresetCopies(workRoot, { presetKeys: ["base"] })` must continue to create or update `.senti/presets/base/guardrail.json` with content equal to `src/presets/base/guardrail.json`.
requirements.note: R3: deployPresetCopies preserves the base guardrail.json managed copy only

requirements.desc: `deployPresetCopies(workRoot, { presetKeys: ["base"] })` must continue to create or update `.senti/presets/base/guardrail-rewrite-rubric.md` with content equal to `src/presets/base/guardrail-rewrite-rubric.md`.
requirements.note: R4: deployPresetCopies preserves the base guardrail rewrite rubric managed copy only

requirements.desc: `deployPresetCopies()` must not copy `guardrail-rewrite-rubric.md` for non-base preset keys; the only rubric managed copy path in this change is `.senti/presets/base/guardrail-rewrite-rubric.md`.
requirements.note: R5: deployPresetCopies does not create non-base guardrail rewrite rubric managed copies

requirements.desc: Regression tests must prove R1 through R5 using spec-local coverage under `specs/307-stop-creating-presets-template/tests/`.
requirements.note: R6: spec-local regression covers all deployPresetCopies generation targets
